voice_cues.speaker: narrator
voice_cues.text: Imagine looking up tonight and finding the Moon gone. The sky would be darker, but the real surprise would be down here.

voice_cues.speaker: narrator
voice_cues.text: The Moon's gravity helps shape Earth's tides. But it isn't the only influence. The Sun pulls on our oceans, too.

voice_cues.speaker: character
voice_cues.text: Wait. So the tides wouldn't just stop?

voice_cues.speaker: narrator
voice_cues.text: Right. Solar tides would still exist. Their patterns and strength would differ from the combined tides we know today, and local geography would still matter.

voice_cues.speaker: narrator
voice_cues.text: That's only one piece of the puzzle. How would a moonless world change the nights, the oceans, and the life that depends on them?
